name: Product
description: Task-oriented interfaces for Wonka products, internal tools, and agent workspaces.

constraints.value: Support 320px through large desktop layouts without horizontal scrolling.
Text and visible focus indicators meet their WCAG 2.2 AA contrast thresholds.
Every interactive flow remains operable with a keyboard and retains visible focus.
Non-essential motion respects the user’s reduced-motion preference.
Interactive elements define loading, empty, error, disabled, focus, and success states where applicable.
Treat Product as externally distributed by default. Internal-only surfaces require a dedicated channel before verified_internal assets can be selected.
